verdict.rationale: monday.com documents its own agents that you can message or @mention and that reply in conversations, plus a claim to 'surface deep intelligence and actionable insights from any subject.' That loosely supports asking AI about workspace work, but nothing describes a Q&A or search experience over workspace content, and nothing mentions citations or source attribution. The MCP and Claude/ChatGPT connectors are external-tool routes and earn no credit here. Missing for 10: explicit workspace-wide AI question-answering, citations or source links in answers, evidence of instant answer speed, independent or hands-on corroboration.
